defaults() - Static method in class org.tomlj.TomlParseOptions
The default parse options: TomlVersion.LATEST, with a maximum nesting depth of 128, keeping the text of the document parsed so that it can be written back as it was read.
defaults() - Static method in class org.tomlj.TomlWriteOptions
The default options: LAYOUT, no indentation, a maximum line width of 80, no line separator of their own, so that lines end with the platform's, System.lineSeparator(), and output written for TomlVersion.LATEST.
